categories.empty: No categories. Without them, the analysis by category stays empty.

actors.empty: No counterparties. The first movement you declare creates one.
actors.leftBehind: {count, plural, one {# movement already declared does not follow} other {# movements already declared do not follow}}: <link>attach the history</link> brings them along, now or later.

merge.label: Merge
merge.description: Everything declared under “{name}” moves to the chosen counterparty, and “{name}” becomes one of its aliases. This is the only action here that rewrites movements already declared.

reattach.title: Attach the history of {actor} to {activity}?
reattach.nothing: Nothing to attach: the history of {actor} is already under {activity}, or filed under another activity.
reattach.count: {count, plural, one {# movement} other {# movements}} will move under {activity}. A movement filed under another activity stays put.
reattach.countSince: {count, plural, one {# movement} other {# movements}} since {since} will move under {activity}. A movement filed under another activity stays put.

connectAi.authorizeHint: Your AI opens abacus in the browser: sign in, then authorize.

revoke.title: Revoke access for “{name}”?
revoke.description: It loses access within ten minutes at most. To connect it again, you will have to authorize it again.
